**Status: partial** — the cut is implemented and `cargo check --locked` passes, but `cargo check --locked --tests` still has 5 errors in two sheet-specific test files I had not yet converted when the turn budget ran out. No commits made; everything is uncommitted in the worktree.

## Result

**Done and verified:**
- `cargo check --locked` passes in `/Users/sachinkoli/.hoocode/worktrees/noteapp/trim-tables` (branch `agent/trim-tables`, base `4104d2b`). Build required cloning the parent's `target/` dir into the worktree (read-only `cp -cR`; the sandbox has no `metal` compiler so gpui can't rebuild from scratch).
- GFM Markdown tables stay fully working (layout/render/edit in `views/editor/grid.rs` + `table.rs` kept, minus formula evaluation). CSV files now open as editable text; `kanban: true` notes render as plain Markdown (`kanban::is_board` gone; all board/sheet call sites removed).

**Files deleted (staged `D`):** `src/views/sheet/` (7 files), `src/views/kanban.rs` (replaced by stub, see below), `src/logic/table.rs`, `src/logic/formula.rs`, `src/shell/board.rs`, `src/shell/tables.rs`, `src/views/editor/formulas.rs`, tests `end_to_end/csv.rs`, `end_to_end/boards.rs`, `end_to_end/table_formulas.rs`, `sheet_header.rs`, `board_header.rs`, `table_open.rs`, `book/src/csv.md`, `book/src/tables.md`, `book/src/boards.md`. Debris `src/views/editor/grid.rs` was **kept** (stripped of `=FORMULA()` evaluation only) — full removal would delete GFM table rendering the task says stays.
**Files changed:** `logic/mod.rs`, `mcp/guide.rs` (dropped csv/tables/boards entries — `include_str!` would not compile), `views/editor/{mod,grid,completion,paint,mouse,render,table,links}.rs`, `shell/{mod,pane,notes,render,travel,files,tabs,library,sharing,help,sidebar,drops,palette_open}.rs`, `views/{palette,nav}.rs`, tests `end_to_end/{mod,history_panes,vault_views}`, `tests/{mod,benches,editing,keyboard,feedback,layout}.rs`.
**Verification:** `cargo check --locked` → `Finished dev profile`, 19 warnings (all pre-existing except two I fixed: removed now-unused `Editor::rewrite`, underscore-prefixed unused `window`). `cargo check --locked --tests` → 5 errors remain (see below). No test run completed.

**Not verified / remaining work:** fix the 5 test-compile errors (`save_close.rs:143,151,169,172` — `failed_close_keeps_csv_and_tsv_edits_until_the_final_write` must be rewritten for text-based CSV, mirroring note-close semantics; `sharing.rs:226` — drop the `Data.csv` sheet branch from the share-entries loop), then run `cargo test --locked` (GFM table tests: `md_tables`, `table_handles`, `table_styles`, `editing`, `history_panes`, `layout`).

**REPORT list for the integrator** (forbidden files, exact removals, not done here):
- `src/shell/keymap.rs`: `sheet::` help rows (~L200–214), `TableAutoSum`/`TableCopyResults` rows (~L255–256), `kanban::` rows (~L274–281), `Sheet`-context bindings (~L502–537), `Board`-context bindings (~L649–663 + L646–647 undo), `TableAutoSum`/`TableCopyResults` bindings (~L625,627); `help_sections` entries "CSV tables", "Formulas", kanban board rows.
- `src/views/sheet.rs`, `src/views/kanban.rs` (stubs I added): delete together with the keymap lines above.
- `book/src/SUMMARY.md`: remove `csv.md`, `tables.md`, `boards.md` lines; also fix cross-links from `writing.md`/`performance.md` (CSV benchmark mentions).
- `src/logic/commands.rs` (~L220–313): `sheet::`-named catalog entries now dead (action types still exist via stubs); `editor::TableAutoSum`/`TableCopyResults` entries dead (no handlers).
- `src/actions.rs`, `src/main.rs`, `book/src/shortcuts.md`: no changes needed.

**Behavior changes:** CSV/TSV grid gone (open as text; sheet-specific share/undo/history paths removed); in-note `=FORMULA()` shows as plain text (no results, `#ERR`, auto-sum, copy-results, or `=`-completion); kanban board UI, toggle button, and palette entry gone; per-file undo/redo of sheets gone. LaTeX `$…$` formulas untouched.

**Open questions:** (1) keep or delete `vault::is_table` + csv/tsv tree icons (`table.svg`) — I kept both so CSVs stay visible/openable as text; (2) whether `TableAutoSum`/`TableCopyResults` action definitions should stay as permanent no-ops or be removed with the keymap lines (I kept them so the frozen registry compiles).
